entries.headline: Novavax XFG COVID-19 vaccine joins public programme; eligible people aged 12+ can choose
entries.zh: 連假將至 籲請符合流感及新冠疫苗公費接種資格民眾儘早接種 增加保護力 還可獲得健康幣
entries.why: Public programme (公費): Taiwan CDC's pre-holiday appeal lists Novavax as an option from October 19, and outlets explain that public-eligible people aged 12+ can choose a brand. On October 13 CDC also said it plans additional Novavax doses.
entries.headline_zh: Novavax XFG COVID-19疫苗納入公費，12歲以上符合資格者可選擇
entries.why_zh: 公費：疾管署連假前呼籲接種，列出10月19日起可選擇Novavax，媒體說明12歲以上公費對象可自選廠牌。疾管署10月13日亦表示規劃追加Novavax疫苗。

entries.headline: CDC extends public flu antiviral eligibility to November 15 as severity stays high
entries.zh: 因應流感疫情仍處流行期，公費流感抗病毒藥劑擴大用藥條件將延長至2026年11月15日止
entries.why: Public programme (公費): the extension comes as media cite 159 new severe cases, 44 weekly deaths, 123,000 weekly medical visits and H1N1 above 90%. It signals CDC expects sustained flu pressure into November.
entries.headline_zh: 重症持續高檔，疾管署延長公費流感抗病毒藥劑擴大用藥至11月15日
entries.why_zh: 公費：延長措施之際，媒體引述新增159例重症、單週44例死亡、單週12.3萬就診人次，H1N1占比逾90%。顯示疾管署預期流感壓力將延續至11月。

entries.headline: CDC debunks viral claim of a Pentagon ban on Moderna's mRNA flu vaccine
entries.zh: 疾管署澄清網傳「十月十四日突發消息：五角大廈已在全美軍範圍內禁止採購和接種莫德納Moderna的mRNA流感疫苗」，為錯誤訊息並非事實，請民眾勿信勿轉傳
entries.why: CDC says the US military has not covered the product only because US CDC has not recommended it. Over a dozen outlets carried the clarification, and some headlines widened it to 'Moderna vaccine in trouble', a trust issue for mRNA products that sits outside the public/self-pay split.
entries.headline_zh: 疾管署澄清網傳美國國防部禁用Moderna mRNA流感疫苗
entries.why_zh: 疾管署表示，美軍未給付該產品僅因美國CDC尚未建議使用。逾十家媒體報導此澄清，部分標題擴大為「Moderna疫苗出事」，對mRNA產品構成信任議題，且不屬公費／自費範疇。

entries.headline: Public flu shots pass 3.24 million, up 9.5% year on year; COVID-19 passes 1.01 million
entries.why: Public programme (公費): multiple outlets report uptake ahead of last year and a CDC estimate of the next wave's timing, which supports CDC's case for top-up orders.
entries.headline_zh: 公費流感疫苗接種突破324萬劑，年增9.5%；COVID-19疫苗突破101萬劑
entries.why_zh: 公費：多家媒體報導接種量超前去年，並引述疾管署對下一波疫情時間的預估，支持疾管署追加採購的理由。

entries.headline: Doctors link flu to sharply higher cardiac risk in over-65s, citing enhanced vaccines
entries.why: Health-professional coverage on Sanlih, UDN and LINE TODAY discusses adjuvanted and high-dose flu vaccines without stating funding. Separately, Malan Veterans Home reports public enhanced-flu vaccination starting, even as enhanced-flu volume fell week on week (38 to 23 items).
entries.headline_zh: 醫師指流感使65歲以上心臟風險大增，並提及加強型疫苗
entries.why_zh: 三立、聯合報及LINE TODAY的醫療專業報導討論佐劑型及高劑量流感疫苗，未說明經費來源。另外，馬蘭榮家公布開始接種公費加強型流感疫苗，惟加強型流感聲量較上週下滑（38則降至23則）。

entries.headline: Threads posts recycle COVID-19 safety claims; 'saline' post draws over 2,000 engagements
entries.why: Posts claim, without evidence, that vaccines are saline or contain parasites, or that they damage the spleen or cause stillbirths. These are unverified social signals; the funding arena is not stated, and most posts have low engagement.
entries.headline_zh: Threads貼文重炒COVID-19疫苗安全性說法；「食鹽水」貼文互動逾2,000次
entries.why_zh: 貼文在無證據下宣稱疫苗是食鹽水或含寄生蟲，或會傷害脾臟、導致死產。此為未經查證的社群訊號；未說明公費或自費，且多數貼文互動低。

watch.text: Second stage of the public flu programme opens; watch for supply, top-up delivery and eligibility questions.
watch.text_zh: 公費流感疫苗第二階段開打；留意供應、追加到貨及資格相關疑問。

watch.text: Expanded public flu antiviral eligibility expires; watch whether CDC extends it again given current severity.
watch.text_zh: 公費流感抗病毒藥劑擴大用藥到期；留意疾管署是否因應現況再度延長。

watch.text: CDC and local health bureaus are pushing vaccination before the holiday; watch the post-holiday uptake figures and CDC's next-wave estimate.
watch.when_zh: 即將到來的光復節連假
watch.text_zh: 疾管署及地方衛生局正推動連假前接種；留意連假後接種數據及疾管署下一波疫情預估。

qa.q: Is Novavax actually in the public programme now, and for whom?
qa.a: Yes. Per CDC and multiple outlets, public-eligible people aged 12+ can choose Novavax from October 19, and CDC said on October 13 that it plans additional Novavax doses.
qa.q_zh: Novavax現在是否確已納入公費？適用對象為何？
qa.a_zh: 是。根據疾管署及多家媒體，12歲以上公費對象自10月19日起可選擇Novavax，疾管署並於10月13日表示規劃追加Novavax疫苗。

qa.q: Is the Moderna 'Pentagon ban' rumour spreading beyond the debunk?
qa.a: Coverage is overwhelmingly media reporting of CDC's October 20 clarification. However, several headlines blur the flu product into 'Moderna vaccine in trouble', so brand-level confusion is possible. It is a 7-day new storyline with no prior volume.
qa.q_zh: Moderna「國防部禁用」謠言是否在澄清後仍擴散？
qa.a_zh: 聲量絕大多數為媒體報導疾管署10月20日的澄清。然而數則標題將流感產品模糊成「Moderna疫苗出事」，可能造成品牌層級混淆。此為近7日新議題，先前無聲量。

qa.q: Is there any self-pay (自費) or enhanced-flu signal this week?
qa.a: Thin. Doctor-led articles discuss adjuvanted and high-dose vaccines for over-65s without stating funding. Posts report clinic registration fees of NT$150-200 for public flu shots, and one post cites NT$16,000 per dose for an infant RSV antibody. Enhanced-flu and RSV volumes fell week on week, and Tdap had no items.
qa.q_zh: 本週是否有自費或加強型流感疫苗相關訊號？
qa.a_zh: 很少。醫師主導的文章討論65歲以上適用的佐劑型及高劑量疫苗，未說明經費來源。有貼文指公費流感疫苗診所掛號費NT$150-200，另一則貼文提到嬰兒RSV抗體每劑NT$16,000。加強型流感及RSV聲量較上週下滑，Tdap無相關則數。

policy_notes.why: This pre-launch notice set the phase-one eligibility for 11 groups and the 1,350 health-coin incentive, and it referenced self-pay options, defining the boundary between the public and self-pay arenas.
policy_notes.why_zh: 此開打前公告訂定第一階段11類接種對象及1,350健康幣獎勵，並提及自費選項，劃定公費與自費的界線。

policy_notes.why: Formal launch of the joint 左流右新 campaign confirms enhanced flu vaccines are prioritised for long-term care residents 65+ and that both Moderna and Novavax are part of COVID-19 supply.
policy_notes.why_zh: 「左流右新」聯合接種活動正式啟動，確認加強型流感疫苗優先提供65歲以上長照機構住民，且Moderna與Novavax均為COVID-19疫苗供應來源。

policy_notes.why: This notice set the 2026-27 narrative that public flu and COVID-19 uptake is outpacing last year and urged high-risk groups to vaccinate before holiday travel.
policy_notes.why_zh: 此公告定調2026-27年度敘事：公費流感與COVID-19疫苗接種進度超越去年，並呼籲高風險族群於連假出遊前接種。

policy_notes.why: Confirms Novavax's public-programme entry from October 19 and plans for additional flu and Novavax doses, shaping supply expectations for the rest of the season.
policy_notes.why_zh: 確認Novavax自10月19日納入公費，並規劃追加流感及Novavax疫苗，形塑本季後續供應預期。

policy_notes.why: Restates the pre-holiday call with health-coin incentives and lists Novavax as an option, keeping public-programme demand high.
policy_notes.why_zh: 重申連假前接種呼籲並搭配健康幣誘因，列出Novavax為選項，維持公費需求熱度。

policy_notes.why: Extending public antiviral eligibility to November 15 is an official signal that the flu epidemic period continues, which frames severity coverage.
policy_notes.why_zh: 公費抗病毒藥劑擴大用藥延長至11月15日，是流感流行期持續的官方訊號，形塑重症相關報導框架。

policy_notes.why: This physician-facing letter on the same antiviral extension shows CDC is mobilising clinicians, not just the public.
policy_notes.why_zh: 這封針對同一抗病毒藥劑延長措施的致醫師函，顯示疾管署不僅向民眾、也在動員臨床醫師。

policy_notes.why: CDC's direct rebuttal of a foreign-sourced mRNA rumour sets the official reference point that companies can cite if brand confusion spreads.
policy_notes.why_zh: 疾管署直接駁斥源自國外的mRNA謠言，建立官方參考依據，若品牌混淆擴散，企業可加以引用。

misinfo.claim: COVID-19 vaccines are 'saline' or secretly more dangerous than claimed
misinfo.note: Highest-engagement post this week (2,126 interactions); track spread and keep CDC/TFDA safety-monitoring references ready, with no direct public engagement.
misinfo.claim_zh: COVID-19疫苗是「食鹽水」或暗藏比宣稱更高的風險
misinfo.note_zh: 本週互動最高貼文（2,126次互動）；追蹤擴散情形，備妥疾管署／食藥署安全監測資料，不直接公開回應。

misinfo.claim: US military (Pentagon) banned Moderna's mRNA flu vaccine
misinfo.note: CDC has already declared it false; monitor whether headlines conflate it with COVID-19 vaccines and point stakeholders to CDC's clarification.
misinfo.claim_zh: 美軍（國防部）禁用Moderna mRNA流感疫苗
misinfo.note_zh: 疾管署已澄清不實；監測標題是否與COVID-19疫苗混淆，並引導利害關係人參閱疾管署澄清。

misinfo.claim: COVID-19 vaccines damage the spleen or immune system, or cause hair loss
misinfo.note: Low-engagement recurring posts, some pushing detox products; log them and escalate only if picked up by media or KOLs.
misinfo.claim_zh: COVID-19疫苗傷害脾臟或免疫系統，或導致掉髮
misinfo.note_zh: 低互動的重複貼文，部分推銷排毒產品；予以記錄，僅在媒體或KOL引用時升級處理。

misinfo.claim: COVID-19 vaccination in pregnancy caused a rise in stillbirths
misinfo.note: A single repost of an unverified US claim; keep maternal-safety evidence references ready for medical-society stakeholders.
misinfo.claim_zh: 孕期接種COVID-19疫苗導致死產增加
misinfo.note_zh: 單一轉貼未經查證的美國說法；為醫學會利害關係人備妥孕產婦安全性實證資料。

misinfo.claim: COVID-19 vaccines killed 400 million people or contain parasites
misinfo.note: Conspiracy posts with minimal reach; monitor only.
misinfo.claim_zh: COVID-19疫苗害死4億人或含寄生蟲
misinfo.note_zh: 觸及極低的陰謀論貼文；僅需監測。

products.name: Beyfortus
products.signal: Thin: one social post from a pregnant user recommends an RSV monoclonal antibody for infants under one, citing NT$16,000 per dose and a 32-36 week prenatal window; no product is named and RSV volume fell from 30 to 12 items.
products.implication: The post appears to blend infant antibody and prenatal dosing timing, suggesting parents may still be unclear on options and cost in the self-pay arena; there is no public-programme news this week.
products.action: Keep a label-consistent evidence pack on infant RSV immunisation timing ready for paediatric and obstetric stakeholders, and continue monitoring parent forums for cost and timing confusion.
products.signal_zh: 很少：一名孕婦在社群貼文推薦未滿一歲嬰兒使用RSV單株抗體，提及每劑NT$16,000及產前32-36週時間窗；未指名產品，RSV聲量由30則降至12則。
products.implication_zh: 該貼文似乎混淆了嬰兒抗體與產前接種時機，顯示家長對自費選項與費用可能仍不清楚；本週無公費相關新聞。
products.action_zh: 為兒科及婦產科利害關係人備妥符合仿單的嬰兒RSV免疫時機實證資料，並持續監測家長論壇對費用與時機的混淆。

products.name: High-dose influenza vaccine
products.sub: Efluelda, licensed 65+, in public programme for LTC residents
products.signal: Doctor-led articles in 三立, UDN and LINE TODAY link influenza to heart attack and stroke risk in people over 65 and discuss high-dose and adjuvanted vaccines; a veterans home began public vaccination including enhanced flu. High-dose volume fell from 14 to 9 items.
products.implication: Cardiovascular-risk framing by clinicians keeps enhanced vaccines in media, but product-adjacent consumer articles carry compliance sensitivity under Taiwan's prescription-medicine advertising rules.
products.action: Support geriatric and cardiology stakeholders with balanced scientific evidence on influenza and cardiovascular outcomes, review any company-linked media engagement for compliance, and track enhanced-dose rollout in long-term care facilities.
who: Long-term care and veterans home operators
products.sub_zh: Efluelda，核准65歲以上，長照機構住民公費接種
products.signal_zh: 三立、聯合報及LINE TODAY的醫師主導文章將流感與65歲以上心肌梗塞及中風風險連結，並討論高劑量及佐劑型疫苗；一處榮家開始公費接種（含加強型流感疫苗）。高劑量聲量由14則降至9則。
products.implication_zh: 臨床醫師以心血管風險切入，使加強型疫苗維持媒體曝光，但涉及產品的消費者文章在台灣處方藥廣告規範下具法遵敏感性。
products.action_zh: 以平衡的科學實證支持老年醫學及心臟科利害關係人了解流感與心血管結果，審視任何與企業相關的媒體互動是否合規，並追蹤長照機構加強型疫苗推行情形。
who_zh: 老年醫學及心臟科醫師
長照機構及榮家經營者

products.name: Tdap booster
products.signal: No Tdap items this week, down from 7 the week before; nothing on policy, coverage or public conversation.
products.implication: Tdap is absent from the public conversation while flu and COVID-19 dominate, so there is no live issue but also low visibility.
products.action: Hold maternal and adult pertussis evidence and stakeholder contacts ready, and keep monitoring for pertussis case reports or programme changes.
who: Medical societies for chronic lung disease
products.signal_zh: 本週無Tdap相關則數，上週為7則；政策、接種率或公眾討論皆無。
products.implication_zh: 流感與COVID-19主導討論下，Tdap未見於公眾討論，雖無即時議題，但能見度也低。
products.action_zh: 備妥孕產婦及成人百日咳實證資料與利害關係人聯繫窗口，持續監測百日咳病例報告或計畫變動。

products.name: Novavax (Nuvaxovid) XFG COVID-19 vaccine
products.signal: Taiwan CDC added a publicly funded Novavax COVID-19 option from October 19, said it plans additional Novavax doses, and repeated the option in its October 20 holiday call; several outlets explained that eligible people aged 12 and over can choose it.
products.implication: This is a public-programme (公費) launch in its first days, so attention will turn to site availability, dose allocation and eligibility clarity.
products.action: Coordinate with Taiwan CDC and local health bureaus on dose distribution and site-level availability information, prepare factual eligibility Q&A for frontline clinics, and monitor for any brand-specific safety claims.
products.signal_zh: 疾管署自10月19日起新增Novavax公費COVID-19疫苗選項，表示規劃追加Novavax疫苗，並在10月20日連假呼籲中重申此選項；多家媒體說明12歲以上符合資格者可選擇。
products.implication_zh: 此為公費上路初期，關注焦點將轉向接種點供應、劑量配置及資格說明是否清楚。
products.action_zh: 與疾管署及地方衛生局協調疫苗配送及接種點供應資訊，為第一線診所準備資格Q&A，並監測任何針對品牌的安全性說法。

issues.title: Site-level availability questions for the new Novavax public option
issues.note: Taiwan CDC says more Novavax doses are planned; expect public and media questions about which clinics stock it as the option becomes known.
issues.title_zh: Novavax公費新選項的接種點供應疑問
issues.note_zh: 疾管署表示規劃追加Novavax疫苗；隨選項周知，預期民眾與媒體將詢問哪些診所有貨。

issues.title: Second-stage flu eligibility opens amid a severe H1N1 season
issues.note: With 44 weekly flu deaths and antivirals extended to November 15, scrutiny of programme reach and enhanced-vaccine coverage for older adults may rise.
issues.title_zh: H1N1嚴峻流行季中，流感疫苗第二階段開放
issues.note_zh: 單週44例流感死亡、抗病毒藥劑延長至11月15日，外界對計畫涵蓋程度及長者加強型疫苗覆蓋的檢視可能升高。

issues.title: Vaccine-ban style rumours spreading to other brands
issues.note: The Pentagon-ban rumour was quickly debunked by Taiwan CDC, and unverified COVID-19 safety posts are circulating, one with over 2,000 engagements; a brand-specific rumour template could recur.
issues.title_zh: 「疫苗禁用」類謠言擴及其他品牌
issues.note_zh: 國防部禁用謠言已遭疾管署迅速澄清，另有未經查證的COVID-19疫苗安全性貼文流傳，其中一則互動逾2,000次；針對特定品牌的謠言模式可能再現。

self_pay.title: Registration fees shape out-of-pocket cost of public shots
self_pay.note: A Kaohsiung user reports clinic registration fees of NT$150-200 for a public flu shot and asks where it is cheapest, showing price sensitivity even within the public programme.
self_pay.title_zh: 掛號費影響公費疫苗自付成本
self_pay.note_zh: 一名高雄網友表示公費流感疫苗診所掛號費NT$150-200，並詢問哪裡最便宜，顯示即使在公費範疇內也有價格敏感度。

self_pay.title: RSV infant antibody price cited at NT$16,000
self_pay.note: One post cites NT$16,000 per dose for an infant RSV antibody; this is a single social signal, not a verified price, and no clinic stock information appears.
self_pay.note_zh: 一則貼文提到嬰兒RSV抗體每劑NT$16,000；此為單一社群訊號，非經查證價格，亦無診所庫存資訊。

self_pay.title: Little on self-pay enhanced flu or Tdap
self_pay.note: Doctor articles discuss adjuvanted and high-dose flu vaccines for over-65s but do not mention self-pay prices, stock or demand outside eligible groups, and nothing appears on Tdap.
self_pay.title_zh: 自費加強型流感疫苗或Tdap訊息極少
self_pay.note_zh: 醫師文章討論65歲以上適用的佐劑型及高劑量流感疫苗，但未提及自費價格、庫存或符合資格族群以外的需求，Tdap則無任何相關內容。
